name: Misano World Circuit
notes: Misano World Circuit Marco Simoncelli, clockwise since 2007. Raceway loop over the members of OSM relation 8671383. DTM 2018 raced it at night. speed_scale 1.0 is uncalibrated; tyre_wear_mult as the base's Valencia. OSM has no named pit lane here, so the start line is placed by hand on the pit straight (way 624263851, before the Variante del Parco).
